regions.label: InesHeader
regions.evidence: iNES signature and declared NROM PRG/CHR sizes inspected.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three hardware vectors: NMI $8471, reset $8000, IRQ $84FF; fixed NROM context.

regions.label: ChrPatternTiles
regions.evidence: iNES CHR ROM section, fixed NROM PPU pattern-table storage; 512 16-byte planar tiles.
Uniform $FF suffix after last nonuniform bytes; exact boundary inspected, no conflicting CFG or fetch evidence. Specific fill purpose unproven.

regions.label: SpriteRecordsA9A8
regions.evidence: Repeated four-byte sprite records, indexed record consumer $A980/$A98F. $A9A6 BNE is always taken after ORA #$10; false fallthrough excluded.

regions.label: AudioPeriodWords
regions.evidence: Consumer $BF50 masks low nibble, CMP #$0C excludes indices >=12, ASL selects 12 two-byte periods at $BFAB. $BFA7 LDA #0 makes BEQ unconditional.

regions.label: AudioCommandStreams
regions.evidence: Audio entry routines load C2xx/C3xx stream pointers; compact repeated note/duration command encodings, boundary before $C337 code. C17F branch follows nonzero LDA, so no C181 fallthrough.
